home.heroTitle: Your night in the Levant starts with SAFRA
home.heroSubtitle: Hotels, furnished apartments, villas, farms, chalets and camps
home.heroPromise: You pay SAFRA, and SAFRA follows your booking through to checkout. Your support and compensation are our responsibility, not the property's.
home.trustPayment: You pay SAFRA, never the property
home.trustCompensation: Automatic compensation when plans fall through
home.destinationsSubtitle: Cities that stay up with you
home.typesSubtitle: From a Damascene hotel to a camp under the stars
home.howSubtitle: Booking with SAFRA is not instant — and that is deliberate
home.howBody: You pay in full to SAFRA, and we contact the partner to confirm availability within two hours. If they do not confirm: a full refund plus compensation in your wallet.
home.pledgesSubtitle: Three commitments we do not compromise on
home.pledge1Title: Your relationship is with SAFRA, not the property
home.pledge1Body: Support, payment, complaints, changes and cancellation all go through SAFRA. No phone numbers before a booking is confirmed.
home.pledge2Body: No property is listed before SAFRA verifies its documents, photos and address. Look for the “Verified by SAFRA” badge.
home.pledge3Title: Compensation when we let you down
home.pledge3Body: If the partner does not respond in time: cancellation, a full refund, and compensation added to your wallet automatically.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms describe what SAFRA provides, what you agree to, and what we commit to. They are written plainly on purpose — a term nobody understands is a term nobody keeps.
terms.roleBody: SAFRA is an intermediary. The accommodation itself is provided by the partner who owns or manages the property, and that partner is responsible for the state of the place and for receiving you. SAFRA handles listing, booking, payment, support and disputes.
terms.bookingBody:
You choose your dates and pay, and the request then goes to the partner to confirm within 120 minutes.

Same-day bookings close at 17:00 in the city's own time, because arriving late with nothing confirmed is not a stay.
terms.noResponseHeading: If the partner does not answer
terms.noResponseBody:
If the confirmation window passes with no answer, the booking is cancelled automatically, you are refunded in full, and compensation is recorded against the partner.

You pay nothing for a failure you had no part in.
terms.priceBody:
The price shown at checkout is what you are charged, in the listing's own currency. It includes SAFRA's service fee, itemised separately in the breakdown before you pay.

While browsing, prices may be shown converted into a currency you chose. Those figures are indicative and for comparison only; the amount charged is the one in the listing's currency.
terms.cancelBody:
The partner chooses a cancellation policy from a set SAFRA approves and cannot invent terms of their own. The policy is shown on the property page and in the booking details before you pay.

Within the policy's window the refund is never less than 50%.
terms.reviewsBody:
You can review only after a completed stay. A review is never deleted — it can be hidden if it breaks the rules, and it is kept along with the reason it was hidden.

Phone numbers and email addresses are not published inside reviews or messages; they are masked automatically.
terms.disputesBody: If the stay was not as described, or nobody was there to receive you, open a dispute from your account. Opening one freezes the partner's payout for that booking until it is settled.
terms.changesBody: These terms may change. A material change is announced before it takes effect, and an existing booking stays governed by the terms it was made under.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This page explains what we collect about you, why, how long we keep it, and who sees it. It is written from what the system actually does rather than from a template.
privacy.whoHeading: Who is responsible for your data
privacy.whoBody: To be completed before launch: the legal entity, its registered address, and the contact point for privacy questions.
privacy.collectBody:
Account details: your name, email address, phone number and preferred language, and your gender if you choose to state it — optional, used only to address you correctly, and never used in any decision. Your password is stored hashed (Argon2id) and cannot be recovered; a two-factor secret is stored encrypted.

Booking and payment details: dates, guest counts, amounts, the property, and the record of money movements.

Messages and disputes: the text you write to support or in a dispute. Phone numbers and email addresses inside that text are masked automatically before it is stored, and the original is not kept.

Technical data: your IP address, used to limit abuse and protect sign-in.
privacy.whyBody: To make and manage your booking, to take and refund payment, to provide support and settle disputes, to prevent fraud and abuse, and to meet accounting and legal obligations.
privacy.shareBody:
The partner you book with: your name, your dates, and what they need to receive you — no more.

Our payment provider, our email provider, and the storage service that holds photographs and invoices.

We do not sell or rent your data to anyone, and we do not use it for advertising off the platform.
privacy.keepBody:
Booking and payment records are kept for as long as accounting obligations and dispute resolution require.

Export files requested by staff are deleted after seven days. Unsigned payment callbacks are deleted after thirty days.

Property photographs are kept, because they are the evidence of what a listing claimed on the day somebody booked it.

Nothing is hard-deleted automatically; records are archived and remain auditable.
privacy.rightsBody:
You may ask for a copy of your data, for anything wrong to be corrected, for data we have no reason to keep to be deleted, for it to be transferred elsewhere, to object to a particular use, and to withdraw consent where the use rests on it.

You may also complain to the competent supervisory authority. That authority is named before launch.
privacy.cookiesBody:
We use exactly three:

safra_session — essential, and what keeps you signed in. The site does not work without it.

safra-theme — the light or dark appearance you chose.

safra_currency — the currency you prefer to see prices in.

We use no advertising trackers and no third-party analytics.
privacy.contactBody: To be completed before launch: the contact address for privacy questions.
